title: Zankoku na Douwa-tachi
synonyms: Sono Toki Tina wa Kako wo Mita
synopsis: A collection of oneshots: 1. Zankoku na Douwa-tachi (残酷な童話たち, Cruel Fairy Tales) When Martin and his sister were young, they tried to run away from home. They ran into the forest only to find an unexpected gruesome scene: women were hanged on the trees. Both siblings were traumatised and the younger sister ran away. Now, an older Martin desperately tries to find his sister. 2. Blanche (ブランシェ) Blanche's life was perfect. Her father, the mayor, was rich and she got everything she wanted. But one day her house blows up and she's left as the only survivor with no money at all. She vows revenge on the person who blew the house up and plans it with a strange boy she meets... 3. Butaiura no Majutsu-shi (舞台裏の魔術師, Backstage Mage) Lying on the floor after being beaten by his father, Aleister's mother died after saying "I will be reborn. Wait for me until then" and leaving him her precious ring. 17 years later Aleister bumps into a girl and the ring reacts... 4. Sono Toki Teina wa Kako wo Mita (そのときティナは過去を見た) Teina has the ability to see the past and because of her ability, Sergeant Kaiji has requested for her help in in solving a case involving the sudden brutal killings of policemen. title: Never Mind, Darling
synopsis: After an intense night of drinking, Dawoon has a dream about the kiss he and Jin shared back in high school, something he had long forgotten. He feels uneasy but ignores it, blaming the dream on his long hiatus from dating—until he runs into Jin on campus the next day. Jin seems unusually playful and clingy, poking and prodding at feelings buried in Dawoon’s heart. When Dawoon confronts him about it, a casual reply—”We just kissed”—only adds fuel to the fire. As their long-standing friendship begins to blur into something more, Dawoon must confront his own complex feelings while Jin comes face to face with his heart’s desires. (Source: Lezhin US)

His Imagine Breaker's immense strength is literally immeasurable, so hapless Kamijou is listed at the supernatural level of 0. He happens to meet a girl in white hanging off his window balcony. synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito!
